_om: Nissen in English (Secret Santa, rusj.no/en/secret-santa-draw/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. The budget steps are in pounds (PENGER in spill.js) and the gift ideas in data.en/ideer.json are written for the UK. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.

It's the thought that counts – not the price.

Nissetrekning uten lapper i lua: Alle tr: Secret Santa without names in a hat: everyone draws one person to buy a present for – and nobody knows who drew whom.
Legg til alle som er med. Velg budsjett: Add everyone taking part. Choose a budget and a gift day if you like, and who shouldn't draw each other.
Én mobil: send den rundt, og alle holder: One phone: pass it round, and everyone holds a finger on the card. A phone each: everyone gets their own link, which only shows who they're buying for.
Ingen trekker seg selv. På gavedagen kan: Nobody draws themselves. On gift day you can reveal the whole Secret Santa chain and crown the Secret Santa of the year.
Hver sin mobil: Lenken til hver person h: A phone each: each person's link holds only that person's card. The names can't be read straight off the link, but it isn't locked: whoever has a link can open the card – and whoever made the draw can open them all.
Glemt hvem du skal gi til? Åpne lenken d: Forgotten who you're buying for? Open your link again. Whoever made the draw can send it again.
Ingenting sendes via oss. Trekningen lig: Nothing is sent through us. The draw is only on the phone it was made on, so send the links straight away. They still work even if the phone forgets the draw.
Alle henger sammen i én stor ring. Fint: Everyone is linked in one big ring. Handy for handing out the presents: whoever has just been given theirs hands out their own next.
Trenger du hjelp? «Gaveideer» gir forsla: Need help? ‘Gift ideas’ suggests things that fit the budget.
Lenken er ufullstendig eller endret – ka: This link is incomplete or has been changed – maybe it got cut off when it was sent. Ask whoever made the draw to send it again.
Send den rundt – alle holder fingeren på: Pass it round – everyone holds a finger on the card
Alle får sin egen lenke og ser bare sitt: Everyone gets their own link and only sees their own card

Nå er det bare å holde tett til gavedage: Now just keep it quiet until gift day. 🤫

Lenkene virker også om mobilen skulle gl: The links still work even if the phone forgets the draw. If someone has lost theirs, send it again from here.
Lenkene sendes ikke via oss. Navnene kan: The links aren't sent through us. The names can't be read straight off a link, but it isn't locked: whoever has the link can open the card. You made the draw, so you can open them all.

{navn} gjetter først. Så avslører dere é: {navn} guesses first. Then you reveal them one by one.
Alle {n} var nisse for noen – og fikk en: All {n} were Secret Santa for someone – and got a Secret Santa of their own.
Hvem ga den beste gaven? Trykk på navnet: Who gave the best present? Tap their name.
Kortet er bare ditt. Glemmer du hvem du: This card is just for you. If you forget who you're buying for, open the link again.

Har dere trukket på nytt, er det nye kor: If you've drawn again, the new card is the right one.

Da kan dere se hele nissekjeden – hvem s: Then you can see the whole Secret Santa chain – who was Secret Santa for whom. It can't be hidden again.

Trekningen slettes fra denne mobilen. Ha: The draw will be deleted from this phone. If anyone hasn't seen their card, you'll have to draw again.
